//: Where local-only state is backed up (process.md section 1). The folder is the owner's private Google Drive folder; rclone does the transfer. rcloneAccount is any rclone Drive remote authorised for the owner's account - the folder is forced by folderId, so the remote's own root does not matter. This repo's own remote is mandosdrive (rclone config create mandosdrive drive scope=drive root_folder_id=<folderId>; a browser login once - on WSL open the printed 127.0.0.1:53682 link in the Windows browser).

mandos-lab-data.what: the desktop lab build's data base: saves, graveyard and lineage (install storage in the browser profile), settings, logs
